notes.title: Hotfix Announcement (June 20, 2025)
notes.content: [p][b]Version:[/b] [b]1.2.3r3_0[/b][/p][p]Scheduled Update: 2025/06/20 21:30 UTC+8[/p][p]We will be updating the client version to address the known issues stated as follows.[/p][p]Sorry for any inconvenience this may cause, and thanks for your support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Overview[/b]:[/p][p]· Fixed some localization errors.[/p][p]· Fixed the unmatched avatar being displayed while spectating in the Battle Room;[/p][p]· Fixed the visual error caused by the username being too long in Battle Room -> Player List[/p][p]· Fixed glitched icons after switching controllers in the Menu during Training Mode[/p][p]· Fixed unregistered challenge <Upon stage clear, get 45000 points> in Simulacrum Chronicle [/p][p]· Fixed the first hit of the Supermove - Final Getter Tomahawk of Shin Getter Robo under arsenal Shin Getter Tomahawk failing to be blocked by the opponent[/p][p]· Fixed the arsenal move Getter Tomahawk being unable to cancel into Getter Boomerang (236D)  under arsenal Shin Getter Tomahawk[/p][p]· Fixed Shin Getter Robo being frozen at Shin Getter Robo 3 when releasing Shin Getter Rolling Rush (8D) under the arsenal Shin Getter Change in certain circumstances[/p][p]· Fixed Shin Getter Robo's throwescape comboing into arsenal moves mistakenly[/p][p]· Fixed failed Limit Break with DASH input for Shin Getter Robo[/p][p]· Fixed Great Mazinger's Breaker Kick may result in varied performance in off-the-ground attacks.[/p][p][/p][p]Please apply the changes after restarting the game. Thanks for all the fish and your support![/p][p]Iron Saga VS Team[/p]

tags.bug: · Fixed some localization errors.
· Fixed the unmatched avatar being displayed while spectating in the Battle Room;
· Fixed the visual error caused by the username being too long in Battle Room -> Player List
· Fixed glitched icons after switching controllers in the Menu during Training Mode
· Fixed unregistered challenge <Upon stage clear, get 45000 points> in Simulacrum Chronicle
· Fixed the first hit of the Supermove - Final Getter Tomahawk of Shin Getter Robo under arsenal Shin Getter Tomahawk failing to be blocked by the opponent
· Fixed the arsenal move Getter Tomahawk being unable to cancel into Getter Boomerang (236D)  under arsenal Shin Getter Tomahawk
· Fixed Shin Getter Robo being frozen at Shin Getter Robo 3 when releasing Shin Getter Rolling Rush (8D) under the arsenal Shin Getter Change in certain circumstances
· Fixed Shin Getter Robo's throwescape comboing into arsenal moves mistakenly
· Fixed failed Limit Break with DASH input for Shin Getter Robo
· Fixed Great Mazinger's Breaker Kick may result in varied performance in off-the-ground attacks.

notes.title: Maintenance Announcement (April 1, 2025)
notes.content:
·Maintenance Announcement (April 1, 2025)
Commanders,
We will be conducting maintenance for Iron Saga VS on Steam from 16:00 UTC+8. Online play will not be available during the maintenance. You can still play in offline mode.

Maintenance Period:
From 16:00 to 17:00 UTC+8 (~60 minutes)

If the maintenance is not finished by the scheduled time, we may extend the maintenance. We're sorry for any inconvenience this may cause. Thanks again for your understanding and support.

Patch Note 1.0.9.1 (April 1, 2025)
BUG FIX
- Fixed enabled throwescape for the opponent when Nero punished it with frontward/backward throw
- Fixed Nero failing to reset when an air clash happened
- Fixed false link frame upon Getter-3 hitting the opponent with 2A
- Updated the preview videos of certain special moves

Can cancel special moves immediately after DancouKen - Draw

Combat Roll

All-conquering

Extend the recovery by 1F

GTW Fighter Duo

Damage Recovery: Optimized the animation of damage recovery
Regal Ballet
(Jumping ↑+C): Adjusted the frame on block from -1F to +1F
Crouching Medium attack
(↓+B): Adjusted the frame on block from -5F to -4F
Accelerating Sawblade
(↓↙←+A/B/C): Sets the initial action as crouch, enabling the avoidance of attacks that cannot break crouch
(light)Accelerating Sawblade
(↓↙←+A): Decreased the startup from 13F to 10F
Moved the air invincibility from Frame 9 to Frame 6
(medium)Accelerating Sawblade
(↓↙←+B): Increased the range of movement
(heavey)Accelerating Sawblade
(↓↙←+C): Decreased the startup from 18F to 16F
Aerial Waltz
(←+B/→+B): Now can be enabled in the air
Fixed the changed hurtbox when hovering, which resulted in ground damage detection upon getting hit
Path of Thorns
(↓↘→+A/B/C): Fixed follow-up air attacks dismissing combo offset
Nero(Simulacrum): 
Simulacrum summon
(D): Enables earlier recovery when Simulacrum disappears upon getting hit
Simulacrum Crawler Mine
(AC): Increased recovery on block of the opponent from 20F to 24F
Scorching Laser
(Jumping ↓↘→↓↘→+D): Improved the animated presentation
Simulacrum Nutshell: An air parry at no energy cost
Invincible from Frame 8
Charge the weapon gauge no matter it hits or not
Nero (GTW Fighter Duo): 
GTW Fighter Duo: Slightly increased the speed of charging
No longer charges faster in Spiritland the Awakening Supermove 
Crimson Wave
(↓↘→+D): Decreased damage from 120 to 90
Greatly extended the duration
Cerulean Wave
(↓↙←+D): Decreased damage from 120 to 90
Greatly extended the duration
GTW Uppercut
(D): Decreased the startup from 18F to 16F
Increased the ground damage from 50 to 60
Decreased the pushback distance on block
Now jumps higher
GTW Advance
(↓+D): Decreased startup from 19F to 18F
Increased the damage from 50 to 60
Greatly boosts the charge speed
Fixed the false animation on Nero's leg when using this move
GTW Blastoff: Iron Will
(←+D): Decreased the pushback distance on hit or block
GTW Blastoff: Rock Solid
(→+D): Enabled earlier second-phase attack
Spiritland
(AC): Gains Super Armor throughout the duration
Decreased damage from 70 to 50 but immune to damage offset
No longer charges GTW Fighter Duo

notes.title: Maintenance Announcement (March 27, 2025)
notes.content:
Maintenance Announcement (March 27, 2025)
Commanders,
We will be conducting maintenance for Iron Saga VS on Steam from 16:30 UTC+8. Online play will not be available during the maintenance. You can still play in offline mode.

Maintenance Period:
From 16:30 to 17:30UTC+8 (~60minutes)

If the maintenance is not finished by the scheduled time, we may extend the maintenance. We're sorry for any inconvenience this may cause. Thanks again for your understanding and support.

Patch Note 1.0.6.1 (March 27, 2025)
BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS
Mazinger Z (General)	
(Medium) Rocket Punch(↓↘→+B) Increased frame from 43F to 45F
(Heavy)Rocket Punch(↓↘→+C)	Increased frame from 47F to 48F

Narrowed down the hitbox from behind

						Expanded the hitbox upward

Head Crusher(↘+A) Fixed the bug where its leg is placed at a misplaced angle

Increased the flight distance
Changed disadvantage frame on block from -8F to -9F
Narrowed down the hurtbox from above

Changed disadvantage frame on block from -3F to -5F with less pushback distance

Heavy Speeding Halberd(CCC)	Can combo into Medium Speeding Halberd (BBB)
Mountain Crusher(→+AAA) Increased the altitude of the opponent flying to the air after getting hit
Menacing Roller(↓↘→+BC) Adjusted the damage from 150 to 140
						Cannot combo into Reverse Lightning (↓+D)

Victory Sealed(↓↓+BC) Reloads all ammunition
				Lowered the speed of the opponent falling to the ground

Backflow Cannon(←+D) Increased the altitude of the opponent flying to the air after getting hit
						Now bounces the opponent higher
						Invincible to projectiles during flip

Stone-Splitting Archery(↓↘→↓↘→+D) Slightly decreased the altitude of the opponent flying to the air after getting hit
Firestorm Baptism(→↘↓↙←+AB) Increased
						Enabled frontal movement on startup

Divine Punishment(D) Whiff the attack to cancel Thundering Hurl (↓↘→+D)
Sky Piercer(↓↙←+D)	 Sped up the recovery by 6F when this attack is not guarded
						Can cancel Menacing Roller (↓↘→+BC)
						Cannot be crouch block'd

Thundering Hurl(↓↘→+D) Expanded the horizontal hitbox
						Cannot be deflected

Energy Drain(→↘↓↙←+AB) Increased the startup from 16F to 22F
						Enabled frontal movement on startup
						Increased damage from 120 to 130
						Increased the pushback distance between self and the oppoent after hitting the opponent at the corner

BUG FIXES
·Fixed the cursor not moving in personal room.
·Fixed the visual error where Qing Long's Standing Heavy Attack would be displayed as Standing .
·Fixed the background scene of Hinomaru Station more horizontally expanded than other maps.
·Fixed an issue in Training Mode where Vassago's Arsenal Attack "FS Field" doesn't preview correctly.
·Fixed an issue preventing Boss Borot from exiting flight mode when its "Brave Rocket" is blocked by an energy shield.
·Fixed the textual error in Leaderboard for 1st, 2nd and 3rd places
·Updated the general hit sound of fist, foot, blade and other weapons
·Improved the Tutorial


Iron Saga VS Operations Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 18th
notes.content:
Version: 0.6.5.1
Update Time: October 18th, 2024 (UTC+8)

The development team has released a version update today, addressing several known issues. The details are as follows:

1. Fixed visual effect scaling and character teleport errors in certain language environments.
2. Resolved game freezing or errors caused by high-frequency actions when starting or ending online battles.
3. Fixed desynchronization errors that occurred at the start of the second round in online battles.

The update will take effect after the Steam update. Thank you for your support!
